scope: Manually verified Gu relevant to the Qing Mao Mountain opening and the progression boundary through rank three. Rank-four Nine Eyes Liquor Worm is retained only to close the documented Liquor Worm chain.
evidencePolicy: Facts are paraphrased. Evidence stores chapter and source-line locators only; no novel prose is copied.

records.name: 希望蛊
records.form: A luminous swarm found in the flower sea around the clan spirit spring.
abilities: Hope Gu enter a candidate as the candidate advances through spirit-pressure.
Their light opens the aperture and becomes the light membrane that keeps the new aperture stable.
The quantity responding to a candidate is used by onlookers as an early aptitude signal.

acquisition.summary: Received during the Gu Yue clan aperture-awakening ceremony rather than captured as ordinary loot.

feeding.summary: The located passage presents the participating Hope Gu as expended into the aperture membrane.

limitations: Not treated as a normal reusable combat or cultivation inventory Gu in the opening.

records.name: 月光蛊
records.form: A light, translucent blue crescent about the size of a jade pendant.
abilities: Produces a blue moonblade for ranged cutting attacks.
Acts as the foundation of the Gu Yue clan's common moon-series refinement routes.

acquisition.summary: New Gu Yue students normally choose one from the academy Gu room as a vital Gu candidate.

feeding.summary: Consumes four moon-orchid petals per day, split into morning and evening feedings.

development: The source presents multiple mutually exclusive rank-two branches rather than one mandatory linear upgrade.
limitations: A single moonblade costs roughly one tenth of Fang Yuan's primeval essence in the cited opening-state example.
Its base attack, range and trajectory depend strongly on the chosen rank-two branch.

records.name: 小光蛊
records.form: After refinement it can reside as a milky-white five-pointed-star mark on the hand.
abilities: When activated with Moonlight Gu, doubles the moonblade's size and attack in the cited configuration.
Serves as an ingredient in Moon Glow Gu.

acquisition.summary: Fang Yuan selects one from five available in the academy Gu room.

limitations: The cited passage says adding a second separate Little Light Gu does not stack the same support bonus; refinement into Moon Glow Gu is required for the stronger result.

records.name: 酒虫
records.form: A plump pearl-white silkworm-like creature with a faint wine fragrance.
abilities: Refines rank-one green-copper primeval essence upward by one minor stage.
Can compensate for a lower current cultivation stage during essence use, but does not change aperture aptitude.

acquisition.summary: Strong green-bamboo wine lures it from cover; after it drinks and slows, following it reveals the rock fissure leading to the Flower Wine Monk remains.

feeding.summary: One jar of green-bamboo wine sustains it for four days. Inferior rice or turbid wine works only in much larger daily quantities.

development: Rank two: Four Flavors Liquor Worm.
Rank three: Seven Fragrances Liquor Worm.
Rank four: Nine Eyes Liquor Worm.
The located source explicitly says the known chain has no rank-five continuation.
limitations: Rare and harder to refine than Moonlight Gu.
Its cultivation value is constrained by rank; each stage only refines matching-rank essence.
Keeping it creates a recurring alcohol expense and can expose its origin if openly displayed in Gu Yue village.

records.name: 四味酒虫
records.form: A larger Liquor Worm whose body cycles through red, blue, green and yellow.
abilities: Refines rank-two red-steel primeval essence upward by one minor stage.

acquisition.summary: Made from two rank-one Wine Worms and sour, sweet, bitter and spicy wines.

development: Refines onward to Seven Fragrances Liquor Worm at rank three.
limitations: The cited successful refinement consumed more than four hundred primeval stones and carried failure risk, including death or severe damage to an ingredient Gu.

records.name: 七香酒虫
records.form: Not described in the located curated passage.
abilities: Refines rank-three white-silver primeval essence upward by one minor stage.

acquisition.summary: Made from two Four Flavors Liquor Worms and seven fragrant materials.

development: Refines onward to Nine Eyes Liquor Worm at rank four.
limitations: Requires two completed rank-two cultivation Gu, making the chain resource-heavy and failure-sensitive.

records.name: 九眼酒虫
records.form: A pearl-white silkworm form with nine differently colored gem-like eyes around its head.
abilities: Refines rank-four yellow-gold primeval essence upward by one minor stage.

acquisition.summary: Made from two Seven Fragrances Liquor Worms and nine eyes taken from hundred-beast kings.

development: The located source states that this Liquor Worm line has no rank-five continuation.
limitations: Cannot benefit a rank-three Gu Master until rank four is reached.

records.name: 白豕蛊
records.form: A pale, rounded flying Gu; the source emphasizes its rarity more than exact anatomy.
abilities: Gradually adds physical strength until the user gains one boar's strength.
The gained strength remains even if the Gu later dies.

acquisition.summary: Recovered from a single-use Earth Treasury Flower placed behind the first strength trial.

feeding.summary: Consumes the meat of one adult pig every five days.

development: White Boar Gu plus Jade Skin Gu produces rank-two White Jade Gu.
White Jade Gu can continue to rank-three Sky Canopy Gu.
limitations: Daily strengthening use is limited to roughly a quarter-hour before escalating pain.
Feeding requires a recurring supply of whole adult pigs.

records.name: 玉皮蛊
records.form: A flat, broad, pale-green bug with a jade-colored halo.
abilities: Hardens the user's skin with low primeval-essence consumption.
Provides better rank-one defense than Copper Skin Gu.

acquisition.summary: Recovered from the second Earth Treasury Flower after the one-boar-strength gate.
The Gu Yue clan leader separately grants one to Fang Zheng as an advance cultivation reward.

feeding.summary: Consumes two liang of jade every ten days.

development: Can enter either the White Jade defense line or the Gu Yue Moon Raiment team-defense line.
limitations: Jade feed is costly and conspicuous for an unsupported low-rank Gu Master.
The defense is still rank one and can be broken by sufficiently strong physical attacks.

records.name: 白玉蛊
records.form: An oval white-jade, pebble-like Gu.
abilities: Provides substantially stronger continuous defense than rank-one Jade Skin Gu.
Defense consumes more primeval essence as incoming attacks accumulate.

acquisition.summary: Made from White Boar Gu and Jade Skin Gu; Fang Yuan's case also used a snow tusk from a wild-boar king.

feeding.summary: Continues the Jade Skin Gu preference for jade.

development: Can refine onward to rank-three Sky Canopy Gu with a water-path defensive Gu.
limitations: Sustained defense drains primeval essence in proportion to pressure.
The refinement has meaningful economic and failure costs.

records.name: 月芒蛊
records.form: Not separately described in the curated passage.
abilities: Raises moonblade attack to three times the base Moonlight Gu result.

acquisition.summary: Made from one Moonlight Gu and two Little Light Gu.

limitations: Optimizes direct damage but does not provide the range, curved trajectory or ally protection of other moon branches.

records.name: 月霓裳
records.form: A moonlight garment effect around the protected target.
abilities: Defends the user and can extend protection to allies.
Its personal defense is below White Jade Gu, but its team utility is higher.

acquisition.summary: Made from Moonlight Gu and Jade Skin Gu.

development: The source says this rarer line can continue as far as rank-five Treasure Moonlight King Gu.
limitations: Trades peak self-defense for support of other people.

records.name: 月旋蛊
records.form: Changes the moonblade from blue to green.
abilities: Changes moonblade travel from a straight line to a curved trajectory.

acquisition.summary: Made from Moonlight Gu and Whirlwind Gu.

limitations: The cited passage emphasizes trajectory rather than increased raw damage.

records.name: 月痕蛊
records.form: Not separately described in the curated passage.
abilities: Keeps Moonlight Gu's attack strength while doubling range to twenty meters.

acquisition.summary: Made from Moonlight Gu and Trace Stone Gu.

limitations: Provides range rather than a damage increase.

records.name: 隐石蛊
records.form: Stone-like; the detailed shape is not recorded in the curated passage.
abilities: Makes the user's body invisible.
Does not hide clothing or visible blood, making the base form awkward for a clothed person.

acquisition.summary: Captured from the stone-monkey king inside the inheritance stone forest.

development: Refines to rank-two Hidden Scales Gu to include clothing in the invisibility effect.
limitations: Body-only concealment creates obvious floating-clothes or blood clues.

records.name: 隐鳞蛊
records.form: A gray carp-fossil-like Gu with lifelike scales.
abilities: Makes both the user and worn clothing invisible.
Provides a practical infiltration and escape option during the wolf tide.

acquisition.summary: Made from Hidden Stone Gu and Fish Scales Gu using a formula not yet known to the local clans at that point.

limitations: Does not guarantee safety against broad-area threats or sufficiently strong beasts.
Cannot conceal the rank-three Thunder Wings Gu effect when both are activated.

records.name: 九叶生机草
records.form: A nine-leaf grass Gu that can grow from the user's palm and retract into a green mark.
abilities: Each removed leaf becomes a Vitality Leaf healing item.
Primeval essence regrows the harvested leaves, turning the Gu into a renewable medical and trade asset.

acquisition.summary: Transferred to Fang Yuan through the Gu Yue Dong Tu estate settlement.

feeding.summary: Needs only water and sunlight, making upkeep unusually cheap.

limitations: Its strategic value makes ownership politically and economically important inside the clan.

records.name: 地听肉耳草
records.form: A fleshy grass Gu grafted into the side of the head as a replacement ear.
abilities: Detects activity out to three hundred steps in the cited setup.
Its range improves sharply when the root tendrils contact the ground.

acquisition.summary: Recovered from a later Earth Treasury Flower in the hidden inheritance.

feeding.summary: Fed with ginseng roots, which are easy to dry and store.

limitations: Use requires a painful permanent graft into a head wound.
Performance falls when its tendrils cannot reach the earth.

records.name: 水罩蛊
records.form: A jellyfish-like Gu that raises a flowing water shield.
abilities: The cited shield outperforms White Jade Gu's defense in favorable conditions.
Its moving water surface can resist binding pressure, though positioning affects performance.

acquisition.summary: Fang Yuan takes it from Bai Ning Bing after the Gu Yue Qing Shu confrontation.

limitations: Repeated shield breakage injures the Gu and can kill it.
The shield performs poorly if the user cannot stabilize position.

records.name: 天蓬蛊
records.form: Produces a white-light armor effect and hardens the user's skin like white jade.
abilities: Provides rank-three full-body defense.
Reduces cutting effects such as moonblades.

acquisition.summary: Made from rank-two White Jade Gu and a rank-two water-path defensive Gu.

limitations: Still consumes primeval essence under sustained pressure and can be overwhelmed by higher-level attacks.

records.name: 霜妖蛊
records.form: Transforms the user into a frost-demon state.
abilities: Grants powerful frost offense capable of piercing White Jade Gu defense.
Synergizes strongly with an ice-muscle body and an ice-water Gu set.

acquisition.summary: Bai Ning Bing refined one after multiple failed attempts and major resource expenditure.

limitations: Prolonged transformation extinguishes the user's life and leaves an ice statue.
Self-destruction can be used as a desperate one-time escalation and destroys the Gu.

records.name: 锯齿金蜈
records.form: A long golden centipede with two rows of rotating saw teeth; it can contract or extend.
abilities: Functions as a low-essence, high-cutting-power melee weapon.
Its wild will can command the surrounding centipede swarm until refined away.

acquisition.summary: Encountered as a wild rank-three guardian and later forcibly refined after Fang Yuan reached rank three.

development: One documented rank-four route is Electric Teeth Killing Centipede.
limitations: Broken saw teeth recover very slowly without support such as Raw Iron Gu.
Refining away the wild will also removes its natural command of the swarm.

records.name: 雷翼蛊
records.form: Resides as two lightning-shaped marks on the user's back and manifests thunder wings.
abilities: Enables short-duration flight and high mobility.

acquisition.summary: Fang Yuan takes it from the clan's emergency stock after becoming a rank-three pillar.

limitations: Consumes primeval essence quickly.
Cannot be concealed by rank-two Hidden Scales Gu while active.
A damaged or poorly maintained specimen creates a severe falling risk.

records.name: 血月蛊
records.form: Similar to Moonlight Gu and resides as a red crescent mark in the palm.
abilities: Fires a blood-aspected moonblade and leaves a bleeding effect.
Uses an easily sourced blood diet.

acquisition.summary: Fang Yuan selects and refines an uncommon Gu Yue rank-three moon route.

feeding.summary: Feeds on fresh blood, readily obtained from local beasts.

limitations: Only has a ten-meter cited range and mediocre direct attack among rank-three Gu.
On recurring days each month it leaks blood and sharply lowers combat effectiveness.
